caption: The drawing is divided into six sections, arranged in two columns and three rows, each depicting a Western-style saddle with floral designs and two prominent saddle horns. The top left section shows only an outline sketch in pencil with floral patterns and the basic saddle structure. The top right section adds pale yellow shading and color to the saddle and floral designs, with the outline still visible. In the middle left section, more orange, peach, and brown hues are introduced, bringing out the details of the floral patterns and giving some volume to the saddle. The middle right section deepens the brown and reddish tones, emphasizing the contours and further detailing the saddle’s shape and tooled floral pattern. The bottom left section increases the color intensity with darker browns, yellows, and golds, making the engraved floral motif and saddle features stand out more sharply. The bottom right section presents the completed saddle with rich, dark browns and golds, intricate floral tooling, realistic shading, and texture on both the surface of the saddle and the horns, highlighting its three-dimensional form. Each progressive section demonstrates increased color, shading, and detail, culminating in a highly detailed, realistic depiction of the saddle.
title: Saddle (Technique Demonstration)
